defects.section: Section 2: Close every alternate operational network path
defects.summary: Operational transport was exported and permitted ambient flags without cryptographic authorization
defects.directiveRequirement: Make createStagingHttpTransport() private to operational module. Remove ambient flag exceptions (NODE_ENV=test, --write, --mode=staging). Ensure no bypassable exported stage writers or transport hooks exist. Anchor trust roots to approved out-of-band fingerprint (KSHETRA_APPROVED_TRUST_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT) or fail closed. Add adversarial tests.
defects.remediationDetails: Unexported createStagingHttpTransport() from scripts/execute_staging_directive_139.mjs; operational transport is module-private and requires explicit { mode: 'staging', authorized: true } instantiated solely inside gated runStagingExecutionEngine(). Removed ambient flag exceptions; real network calls cannot be made based on NODE_ENV=test, --write, or --mode=staging. Anchored public-key trust resolution in scripts/lib/stagingAuthorization.mjs: if key material is sourced from environment, its SHA-256 SPKI fingerprint must match KSHETRA_APPROVED_TRUST_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT or verifier fails closed with TRUST_ANCHOR_UNAPPROVED. Created createTestTransportAdapter() in tests/helpers/stagingStageTestAdapters.mjs. Added comprehensive adversarial tests in tests/staging-execution-mode-b.test.mjs and tests/staging-authorization-verifier.test.mjs.

defects.section: Section 3: Apply least-privilege authorization to only deployable stages
defects.summary: Operational table allowlist and authorization request included blocked tables and criteria
defects.directiveRequirement: Replace overbroad operational grant with a scope derived strictly from the actual validated execution plan. A table and criterion may be authorized only if its stage is schema-valid, data-ready, deployable, and explicitly eligible. Stages 1, 3, 4 must remain BLOCKED_NOT_DEPLOYABLE with 0 rows outbound. Token scope must exclude all blocked tables and criteria.
defects.remediationDetails: Separated DOCUMENTED_STAGING_TABLE_INVENTORY (11 tables) from least-privilege ALL_AUTHORIZED_STAGING_TABLES (strictly ['public.candidacies']). Defined BLOCKED_STAGING_TABLES (10 tables) and BLOCKED_CRITERIA (CRIT-C02-02, CRIT-E01-02, CRIT-F02-03). In verifyStagingWriteAuthorization(), any token attempting to grant a blocked table throws BLOCKED_TABLE_GRANT_FORBIDDEN; any token attempting to grant a blocked criterion throws BLOCKED_CRITERION_GRANT_FORBIDDEN. In Mode B execution runner, requestedCriteria and requestedTables are derived dynamically from plan.stages where deploymentStatus !== 'BLOCKED_NOT_DEPLOYABLE' && outboundRowsToStaging > 0 (yielding ['CRIT-D02-02'] and ['public.candidacies']). Added adversarial tests proving blocked tables and criteria cannot receive execution grants.

defects.section: Section 4: Prove Stage 1 idempotency against checked-in migrations
defects.summary: Stage 1 child tables in Migration 065 use database-generated IDs causing repeat-write constraint and trigger collisions on pre-seeded DB
defects.directiveRequirement: Reconcile semantics of Migration 065 with Stage 1 payload and Migration 064 constraints. Check natural keys, usable conflict targets, and temporal-validation triggers. If safe repeat-write behavior cannot be proven offline without target-state corroboration, mark Stage 1 BLOCKED_NOT_DEPLOYABLE with 0 outbound rows.
defects.remediationDetails: Audited Migration 065 child tables (organization_relationships, organization_multilingual_names, organization_symbols, organization_aliases). Identified that Migration 065 inserts child rows using Postgres gen_random_uuid(), while Migration 064 enforces temporal non-overlap via advisory-locked triggers and dropped static unique indexes on aliases. Reconciler's deterministic UUIDv5 with PostgREST on_conflict=id cannot match existing random IDs in an already-seeded database, causing unique constraint violations (23505) and temporal overlap trigger exceptions (23514). Because safe repeat-write behavior cannot be guaranteed offline without live target-state corroboration, Stage 1 is marked BLOCKED_NOT_DEPLOYABLE with outboundRowsToStaging: 0 in reconcilePoliticalOrganizations(), stagingExecutionPlan.mjs, and stagingSchemaPreflight.mjs. Dispatches strictly 0 rows to staging.

defects.section: Section 5: Make schema preflight validate the actual contract, not a partial checklist
defects.summary: Schema preflight was a partial sample checklist rather than 100% full-population row validation, and 19 candidate rows violated candidacies_independent_party_check
defects.directiveRequirement: Refactor stagingSchemaPreflight.mjs to validate full outgoing payload contract against committed migrations for 100% of outgoing rows. Check columns, extra/missing fields, types, nullability, enums, FK formats, unique constraints, conflict targets, and provenance. Blocked stages must be reported as blocked. Extend dependency inventory to include Migrations 060-063, 067, 068.
defects.remediationDetails: Rewrote scripts/lib/stagingSchemaPreflight.mjs to perform 100% full-population inspection across all 11,298 candidate rows. Validated all 14 PostgreSQL columns against Migration 051/067 DDL. In reconcileCandidacies(), normalized is_independent = (partyId === null ? true : rawIsIndep), resolving 19 rows in 065_b2_2d_chunked that had party_id: null and is_independent: false which violated CHECK ((is_independent = true AND party_id IS NULL) OR (is_independent = false AND party_id IS NOT NULL)). Added full 14-field database column tuples to every candidate row. Extended plan schemaMigrationFiles in scripts/lib/stagingExecutionPlan.mjs to cover all 14 migrations (001, 040, 050, 051, 059, 060, 061, 062, 063, 064, 065, 066, 067, 068). Blocked stages (1, 3, 4) strictly assert outboundRowsToStaging: 0.
